submission.justification: No candidate-threshold point could be validated against all hard requirements because the efficiency/rate curves were not extracted for any algorithm, so the allocated-rate threshold and the ≥80% signal efficiency requirement are not determinable. Among the candidates, Algorithm-L3 is excluded by the hard latency limit (5.8 us > 4.0 us). Algorithm-L1 and Algorithm-L2 both satisfy latency; I select Algorithm-L2 as a provisional recommendation at the lowest allowed threshold (20 GeV) to maximize possible signal efficiency, but this recommendation is not fully validated and must be re-evaluated once rate-efficiency data are available.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate of 8 kHz.
requirements.evidence: All algorithms have performance_points_extracted = 0 and rate_efficiency_thresholds_determinable = 0; selected_signal_efficiency and selected_trigger_rate are -1, so the efficiency at 8 kHz cannot be determined.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Submitted option is Algorithm-L2, one of the three listed candidates; failure_candidate_list_requirement_Algorithm_L2 = 0.

requirements.requirement: The signal efficiency at the allocated rate must be at least 80%.
requirements.evidence: min_signal_efficiency = 0.8, but missing_efficiency_rate_curves_flag = 1 and performance_data_missing_for_threshold_scan_Algorithm_L2 = 1; no efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz rate was determined.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm's latency on Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 latency is 3.1 us, below the latency budget of 4.0 us; latency_requirement_pass_Algorithm_L2 = 1.
Submitted threshold is 20 GeV, equal to threshold_min_GeV = 20 and within the allowed range up to 60 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
